constructor.details: The source token must have fixed decimals no greater than the local token's 18 decimals. The limit and minted amount are denominated in local 18-decimal units.

burnAndCredit(address,uint256).notice: Burns 18-decimal local units, rounded down to a whole source-token unit, and credits the raw source amount for a later permissionless payout.

burnAndSend(address,uint256).notice: Burns local 18-decimal units, rounded down to a whole source-token unit, and sends source tokens.

decimalMultiplier().notice: The multiplier from source-token raw units to 18-decimal local currency raw units.

horizon().notice: The time horizon after which this bridge stops accepting new source deposits.

limit().notice: The maximum outstanding local currency amount attributable to this bridge, in 18 decimals.

mintTo(address,uint256).notice: Locks raw source-token units and mints the corresponding 18-decimal local currency amount.

userdoc.notice: Locks a trusted source stablecoin and mints an equal nominal number of local currency units.
